_doc: Complexity budget — a RATCHET, not a target (plugins/mega-sdd/CLAUDE.md §Release evidence & complexity budget). tests/benchmarks/test-complexity-budget.sh fails when a measured value exceeds its ceiling. Shrinking is always allowed; lower the ceiling in the same change to lock the gain. Raising a ceiling requires a `raises` entry {change, metric, measured_benefit}: a feature / new stage / new lens / new gate / performance claim cites benchmarks/runbooks/vanilla-vs-megasdd.md results (n >= 3 per arm, vs vanilla); a defect fix cites the regression test that fails without it. No evidence, no raise. Units: bytes / chars / lines exactly as the test measures them.
baseline_measured: 2026-09-26 at 8.8.1 (tree 2f3e947c; lines = git-tracked files only); raised 2026-09-27 (see raises[])

raises.change: lane router (scripts/route-lane.sh + front-door Step 0 + references/direct-lane.md) and delivery check (scripts/delivery-check.sh + execute-bolts end-of-run step + bolt-implementer 5b); pipeline HTML render made opt-in (net shrink, folded in)
raises.measured_benefit: Feature (router): benchmarks/results/vanilla-ab REPORT.md, arm routed vs vanilla, n=3 clean each — xs review-ready 2.65 [2.41-2.69] vs 3.17 [3.13-5.72] min, cost 1.16 vs 1.03 USD (OVERLAP), AC 12/12 both; clinic 26.6 vs 30.0 min, 9.30 vs 7.68 USD (OVERLAP), AC 10/10 both, Critical 0 both — versus the lite pipeline it replaces on greenfield (clinic 70.5 min / 67.33 USD / 126 subagents / 123,824 committed .mega-sdd lines -> 26.6 / 9.30 / 1 / 0). The T01 growth (+2.3 KB, +0.5%) is paid only on the guarded lane. Defect fix (delivery-check): tests/lanes/test-lanes.sh D0-D9 fail without it; on the 16 benchmark repos it flags 9/9 clean mega-sdd runs (missing npm test script, empty-env build, TZ-dependent test, unlinked page) and 0/6 vanilla; routed runs 9/9 PASS. scripts_total_lines includes route-lane.sh + delivery-check.sh (303 lines together) once tracked. +2 lines: resolve-review-tier.sh H1 (standards rides with quality), pinned by tests/size-weighted/test-standards-lens-h1.sh.
